# Digipincode

India's village, pincode and panchayat directory: 6 lakh villages, 1.5 lakh+ pincodes, LGD codes, DIGIPIN and post office details for every place in India.

> Data sources: India Post pincode directory, Census of India, Local Government Directory (LGD), Ministry of Panchayati Raj. Facility data is progressively verified from Census 2011 Village Directory / DCHB records.

## Key pages

- [Home & search](https://digipincode.india-in.workers.dev/): search any pincode, village or panchayat
- [All states](https://digipincode.india-in.workers.dev/states): browse the full state › district › tehsil › village hierarchy
- [DIGIPIN guide & tools](https://digipincode.india-in.workers.dev/digipin/): what is my DIGIPIN, official India Post encoder + decoder
- [Pincode pages](https://digipincode.india-in.workers.dev/haryana/district-jhajjar/pincode-124507): post office, delivery status, villages and panchayats per pincode
- [Village pages](https://digipincode.india-in.workers.dev/haryana/district-kaithal/tehsil-dhand-st/village-aahu-19/pincode-136021): population, LGD/census codes, DIGIPIN, panchayat, post office and facilities
- [Panchayat pages](https://digipincode.india-in.workers.dev/panchayat/1234567): local body details, block, villages
- [Saved pages](https://digipincode.india-in.workers.dev/saved): user favourites (client-side only)

## Site structure (URL v2 — full hierarchy)

/{state} — all districts of a state
/{state}/district-{district} — sub-districts, village stats, largest villages
/{state}/district-{district}/{tehsil|taluk}-{tehsil} — all villages with pincodes
/{state}/district-{district}/{tehsil|taluk}-{tehsil}/village-{village}/pincode-{pincode} — individual village profile
/{state}/district-{district}/pincode-{6-digit-pincode} — post office and area details
/panchayat/{lgd-code} — panchayat administration details
/digipin/ — DIGIPIN guide, finder and decoder (official India Post algorithm)

Legacy short URLs (/village/…, /pincode/…, /state/…) permanently redirect (301) to the hierarchy URLs above.

## Notes

- Facility fields on village pages show collection status until verified Census 2011 values are imported — no invented data.
- User corrections welcome via the Report an Issue button on every page.
